entries: I spent so long in the dark that I find it rather comforting to talk to myself.
我在黑暗里待得太久，如今自言自语反而让我觉得安心。
I do not know of this. If it can make a blade, then I do not care what it is called.
这个我不知道。只要能打造刀刃，它叫什么我都不在乎。

I entered the caverns looking for it. I do not recall how long I wandered the musty tunnels before I found you. The book is of great importance, and I was willing to risk my life for it.

I still am.

我进入这些洞窟，就是为了找它。我记不清在霉味弥漫的坑道里游荡了多久，才找到你。那本书，至关重要，我甘愿为它冒生命危险。

现在依然如此。
I will travel anywhere it is needed to fulfill my duties. Land, sea and powers of darkness will not stop me.
为了履行职责，哪里需要，我就去往哪里。陆地、海洋和黑暗的势力都拦不住我。
My list of friends grows. This is an unexpected joy. And yet, not without risk. New trust is easily broken.
我的友人名单又添了一位。这是意外之喜。不过，也并非没有风险。新生的信任易于破碎。
I knew one once. I think. The struggle to remember... it slows our progress and helps the darkness. We must not give up!
我曾认识一位。我想是的。这般苦苦追忆……拖慢了我们的脚步，反倒帮了黑暗。我们绝不能放弃！

That name sounds familiar. Perhaps it is something I once read about?

No, that cannot be it. I am unable to read.

这名字听着耳熟。也许是我从前读到过的？

不，不可能。我根本不识字。
I would prefer not to tread on sacred ground, if possible. My mother warned me that one might awaken the dead by desecrating their resting places. I have no other memories of my mother.
若非必要，我不愿践踏圣土。母亲告诫过我，亵渎安息之地可能会唤醒亡者。关于母亲，我没有别的记忆了。

I quite like caves. There is something about solitude and the sounds of the earth. Alas, I have very little time for rest. Always am I on an errand for one person or another. It seems my fate to be bound in duty, but in that duty I will not fail.
我很喜欢洞穴。独处与大地之声，自有一番韵味。可惜，我几乎没有时间休息。我总在为这个人那个人奔忙。仿佛我命中注定要受职责之缚——但这份职责，我绝不辜负。
Discipline is necessary to learn to play an instrument, is it not? You must be very disciplined, and I am happy to accompany such a person.
学一件乐器，少不了自律，不是吗？你一定非常自律，我很乐意与这样的人同行。
I welcome company that talks less and does more. Actions always speak louder than words.
我欢迎少说多做的人同行。行动永远比言语响亮。
Don't read too much into this conversation. Not that you would bother to read even if you knew how.
别对这场谈话想太多。反正就算你识字，你也懒得「读」。
This is not an area in which I am confident in speaking. Many creatures must surely exist beyond our knowledge.
这个话题，我说起来没有底气。在我们的认知之外，一定还存在着许多生物。
The world is full of odd creatures. Which is strange, since the only world I know of is this town. I have... gaps... in my... what were we talking about?
世上满是古怪的生物。这就怪了——毕竟我知道的世界，只有这个镇子。我的……记忆有……空洞……我们刚说到哪儿了？
I have never entered it. The elders warned us not to, after all. Why were you so foolish?
我从未进去过。毕竟长辈们警告过我们。你为什么那么傻？

I was sent to find the book. That means I am likely a librarian. Who else would go to such lengths to obtain a book?

And something more... ever since I met you I have been able to read this book that I carry. How is that? I was sure that I could not read.

我奉命去找那本书。这么说，我很可能是个图书管理员。若不是为了书，谁会费这么大周折？

还有……自从遇见你，我随身携带的这本书，我竟然能读懂了。这是怎么回事？我明明确信自己不识字。
You must be very grateful that I found you. I will allow you to return the favor later.
你可得好好感谢我找到了你。这份人情，改天再还也不迟。
Yes, that is its name. It is hard to believe that I forgot it, given the weight of my quest. What else have I forgotten?
对，它就是这个名字。以我这使命的分量，我竟然会忘记它，真难以置信。我还忘了什么？
Half man, half lizard? Never heard of them.
半人半蜥蜴？从没听说过。
You look familiar. I wish I could remember who you are.
你看着眼熟。真希望我能想起你是谁。
No creature of darkness merits the title of lord. It implies reverence, whether from love or fear.
黑暗的生物都不配「领主」这样的头衔。那意味着尊崇，无论源于爱还是恐惧。
If I recall correctly, dogs cannot talk. That would make this conversation meaningless. I will not waste my time on meaningless endeavors.
如果我没记错，狗不会说话。那这场对话就毫无意义了。我不会把时间浪费在无意义的事上。
You would think being stuck in a cave for so long gave me some knowledge of minerals. But, you would be mistaken. I have been so focused on my mission that little else has mattered.
你大概以为，在洞穴里困了这么久，我该对矿物有些了解。那你可就错了。我太专注于使命，别的事几乎都不重要。
I think... I am from this place. And yet, I do not recognize it.
我想……我就是这地方的人。可我竟然认不出它。
It is part of my mission I think. I can remember very little from before you found me.
我想，这是我使命的一部分。在你找到我之前的事，我记得的很少。
You are an unexpected ally, and a chance for personal growth.
你是一位意外的盟友，也是一次自我成长的机会。
A pretty metal. Am I missing something?
一种漂亮的金属。我漏掉了什么吗？
Do not think I am impressed by your strength. Strength of character is far more important. Prove yourself in this way and we will be fine companions.
别以为你的力量能叫我刮目相看。品格的力量重要得多。你若能在这方面证明自己，我们会是很好的同伴。
